title: Aberrant excitatory neuronal ERBB4 promotes Alzheimer's disease pathology.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Found GEO series GSE292137 (BioProject PRJNA1237264) by searching GEO; read its record and file list: 18 mouse hippocampus snRNA-seq (single-nucleus RNA sequencing) samples, each only a 10x barcodes/features/matrix triplet, 1.4 GB tar in total. Downloaded one barcodes file (11,525 nuclei, sample 5F2m2) and one features file (33,695 genes with Ensembl IDs plus a header-less tail of extra features). No cell-type, cluster, EREN or genotype metadata file is deposited; group is only encoded in sample names (WT/5F, sgc/sge, ha/eb).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: No open full text (the PMC link from PubMed points to a different, citing paper). The human analysis of 446 individuals and the mediation analysis come from news coverage and the abstract only; that cohort is likely ROSMAP (Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project), which needs a data-use agreement on Synapse, but I did not confirm that.

a1_downloadable.note: Mouse count matrices download freely from GEO (checked). The human 446-person data is probably controlled-access (not verified).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked the files: no per-nucleus labels. Cell types and the EREN (early-responsive excitatory neuron) state would have to be rebuilt by clustering and marker calling, so the label is constructed, not measured.

a3_inputs_present.note: Gene-by-nucleus count matrices with Ensembl gene IDs are present (checked features file).

a4_units_stated.note: Raw UMI (unique molecular identifier) counts in standard 10x format; units are implicit but standard.

a5_enough_rows.note: The only measured label is the sample's genotype or treatment: 18 mice in about 6 groups of 2-3 (from GEO sample names). Roughly 200,000 nuclei is an estimate from one 11,525-barcode file, and nuclei are not independent examples.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~1.4 GB compressed sparse matrices; subsettable per sample
a6_fits_laptop.note: Fits if loaded sample by sample; not decisive.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not compare; no full text available to give a nucleus count.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any per-cell EREN label would come from the authors' own clustering of these same expression features, so it is circular by construction.

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell foundation models) would fit the data type
backbone.hardware: CPU feasible for embeddings of ~200k nuclei, slow

integration.partner_dataset: Public 5XFAD snRNA-seq atlases on GEO; ROSMAP human snRNA-seq (controlled)
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Does an Erbb4-high excitatory-neuron state seen in mice transfer to human Alzheimer's excitatory neurons? But the human side needs an access application.

controls.positive_control: Recover Erbb4 upregulation in 5XFAD excitatory neurons vs wild type
controls.external_validation: Other public 5XFAD hippocampus snRNA-seq series on GEO

honest_claim_h3: With 18 mice and no deposited cell annotations, a model could only say it separates 5XFAD from wild-type nuclei in 2-3 animals per group, which is confounded by animal and batch.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use single-nucleus gene expression from mouse hippocampus to predict whether a neuron is in the early Alzheimer's-responsive state.
plain_idea.train_on: Gene counts per nucleus from 18 mouse hippocampus samples (about 11,500 nuclei in the one file checked; total unknown).
plain_idea.predict: The neuron state (EREN) or the mouse's genotype; the state is defined by the authors' clustering, and the genotype is known for only 18 animals.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Alzheimer's labs would get a portable score for the early neuron state, but the labels are circular and there are too few animals.

ml_idea: Classify EREN-state excitatory neurons or the mouse's genotype from snRNA-seq using frozen scGPT embeddings. It fails because the cell-state label must be rebuilt from the same features and there are only 18 animals.

effort.compute_note: Estimated only from GEO file sizes; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the independent animals per group in GEO sample names: 18 total, 2-3 per group (done; kills it).

verdict_reason: Fails A2/A8 and A5. GEO GSE292137 holds only raw 10x matrices for 18 mice, with no cell annotations, so the EREN label would be rebuilt by clustering the same features. The only measured label (genotype) has 18 animals, and the human cohort is likely controlled-access.
